payload.comment: Ingestion stage evidence is internally consistent and complete. All split sizes (train 89996, val 10004, test 7180) match the official PathMNIST distribution exactly; subsampled=false confirms full-dataset usage. n_channels=3 and n_classes=9 align with the 9 listed labels. The 28×28×3 resolution is the standard MedMNIST PathMNIST format. Archive MD5, per-split index SHA-256, and code SHA-256 are all present, supporting reproducibility. The test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K from a different clinical center) is correctly recorded as context for downstream interpretation. No deterministic findings were raised. One minor observation: the LLM model is listed as 'qwen3.8' with llm_model_digest=null. This naming does not match the conventional Qwen release nomenclature (e.g., qwen3-32b, qwen2.5-72b), and the absence of a model digest prevents exact weight verification. This is flagged as a verification note only and does not affect the ingestion-stage data integrity. All package versions (torch 2.14.0+cu126, numpy 2.4.6, medmnist 3.0.2, lightning 2.6.5, etc.) are plausible for the stated 2026-10-01 timestamp. No blocking issues detected; proceed to the next stage.
llm_issues: LLM model name 'qwen3.8' does not match standard Qwen release naming conventions; llm_model_digest is null, preventing exact model-weight verification. Request confirmation of the deployed model identity and, if possible, provision of a digest or checksum for reproducibility.
